scripts.build: cross-env SKIP_ENV_VALIDATION=1 yarn workspaces foreach -A --topological run build
scripts.dev: yarn dev:services:up && yarn dev:zoekt:build && yarn dev:prisma:migrate:dev && npm-run-all --print-label --parallel dev:zoekt dev:backend dev:web
scripts.dev:db:up: docker start sherlock-pg 2>/dev/null || docker run -d --name sherlock-pg -e POSTGRES_USER=postgres -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=postgres -e POSTGRES_DB=postgres -p 127.0.0.1:5432:5432 postgres:16-alpine
scripts.dev:redis:up: docker start sherlock-redis 2>/dev/null || docker run -d --name sherlock-redis -p 127.0.0.1:6379:6379 redis:7.2-alpine
scripts.dev:zoekt:build: cd vendor/zoekt && GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.23.4+auto go build -o ../../bin/zoekt-git-index ./cmd/zoekt-git-index && GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.23.4+auto go build -o ../../bin/zoekt-webserver ./cmd/zoekt-webserver
